claims.text: The Chronicle-Herald of 7 October 1967 published Ray MacLeod's front-page story quoting Squadron Leader Bain of the RCAF Air Desk saying the Shag Harbour incident 'is one of the few where we may get something concrete on it'; the 9 October follow-up reported the Navy found 'not a trace... not a clue... not a bit of anything.'
